headline: Steps 1 and 3 are done. Step 2, the upload, is BLOCKED and was not attempted: DesignSync is not available in this session. The Claude Design project f5e5465e-943f-4f68-b52f-608925bc07b0 is still empty and unchanged.

theBlocker.what: The dispatch's premise does not hold. It states 'You have the DesignSync tool; the previous session did not, which is the only reason this is being handed to you.' This session carries the same three MCP servers the previous one did: cursor-ide-browser, plugin-neon-postgres-neon, and user-hauska-cortex (in error state).
theBlocker.howVerified: Full MCP catalog listed, plus two pattern searches — (?i)designsync|design_sync|finalize_plan returned zero matches, and (?i)sync|upload|write_files|project returned only Neon project tools.
theBlocker.noLocalFallback: .ds-sync/resync.mjs documents the upload as agent-side MCP calls ('fetch the anchor before this (DesignSync get_file -> a local file)'). There is no HTTP client, no API token and no CLI upload path anywhere in .ds-sync. Nothing local can drive the transfer.
theBlocker.whyNothingWasImprovised: The dispatch's own stop rule is that a half-applied upload with a fresh anchor is permanent while an un-anchored project merely re-verifies. Reaching a live design project by an unsanctioned route is the strictly worse failure, and it is outward-facing. Stopping and reporting is the correct outcome here.
theBlocker.whatIsNeeded: A seat that actually carries the DesignSync MCP server. The scratch file's OPEN entry from the previous session said the same thing and it is still true.
theBlocker.whatIsReadyForThatSeat: Everything. ds-bundle/ is built, validated and coherent with the PR sources. The upload is a mechanical replay of STEP 2 with no judgement left in it.

uploadRunbookForTheNextSeat.preflight: cd P:\tmp\g82v on branch g86/preview-cards-and-conventions. If the clone is gone, re-clone, npm ci, npm run build, then package-build + package-validate and confirm exit 0 before touching the project.
uploadRunbookForTheNextSeat.approvalExplanationOwedToNick: One approval now covers everything this run uploads plus cleanup of anything a later rebuild drops. He will not be prompted again, and components appear in the picker as they land rather than all at once at the end.
order: 1. write _ds_needs_recompile FIRST — the sentinel fences the app's manifest machinery against a half-uploaded state
2. all content writes EXCEPT _ds_sync.json, chunked <=256 files per call, smaller chunks for fonts/ (44 files, and the server bounds bytes not just file count). On a 500, halve the chunk and retry.
3. no deletes — the project started empty
5. write _ds_sync.json LAST, in its own call. It is the anchor that vouches for everything else.
uploadRunbookForTheNextSeat.stopRule: Any write failure that retries do not clear means STOP. No sentinel re-arm, no _ds_sync.json.

Do not treat the two empty directories as a build fault.
uploadRunbookForTheNextSeat.thenConfirm: DesignSync list_files, count against 417, then give Nick https://claude.ai/design/p/f5e5465e-943f-4f68-b52f-608925bc07b0

whatWasDone.step1: The 15 components package-validate flagged [GRID_OVERFLOW] now present correctly. 11 that rendered wider than their grid cell got cardMode column (full card width per story, nothing dropped); 4 that positioned content outside any cell got cardMode single with an explicit primaryStory. The three shell entries kept their 1100x700 viewport, which matters because viewport IS in the grade key and cardMode deliberately is not. The targeted preview-rebuild succeeded — no CONFIG_STALE, so no fallback build was needed for the remedy itself.
whatWasDone.twoDefectsFoundByLooking: cardMode single fixed the geometry of CompassScrim and StageScrim and left both rendering as an empty white box, because each composes a Region without the ColStack rail height home and .region-canvas collapses to height 0. Separately, conventions.md named four vendor brands inside a refusal guard, in a file that ships. Both fixed. Full detail in the CP2.
whatWasDone.step3: Kit PR #5 open and green with the durable set only: 70 previews, conventions.md, config.json. 72 files. No grades, no .cache, no LICENSE.

wdllRegrade.evidence: The five absolute needles (permitflow, citizenconnect, leaflet, pipedrive, stripe.com) grep clean across the durable set AND across the entire 417-file ds-bundle payload. bastrop and chestnut appear nowhere in the durable set. npm test's constraints suite passes. wdllRegrade.whatWasProbedVsInferred: The demo surface was probed live: GET / , /shell.css and /?cityKey=empty-city all return HTTP 200. The serving REVISION string was not re-read — gcloud could not resolve the service from this shell's project/region defaults and it was not worth chasing, because the constraint is a negative one and nothing in this session touched that repo or ran a deploy. If a reader needs the revision confirmed as 00017-vx4, that is still an unrun check. Note for the next prober: HEAD returns 404 on this service, so probe with GET.
wdllRegrade.theViolation: conventions.md named four vendor brands in a refusal guard. Fixed before the PR. The kit's own gate could not have caught it because walk() skips .design-sync — see D-3.

finishCard: Four met, one met-with-a-fixed-violation, one dropped. The dropped item is the whole point of the dispatch and it is dropped for a tooling reason rather than a work reason: every input it needs is built, validated and on a green PR.

followUpRowsProposed.what: The constraint gate cannot see the directory that now holds shipping source.
followUpRowsProposed.detail: walk() in test/_lib.mjs skips ds-bundle, .ds-sync and .design-sync at ROOT as TOOL_OUTPUT_DIRS, so constraints.test.mjs scans neither conventions.md nor the 73 previews. conventions.md travels verbatim into the uploaded README. The skip was correct when .design-sync held only converter input; the directory changed character at G-85. Widening it touches three scans and re-opens the gate-4 stylesheet false positive it was recorded to prevent, so this wants its own row and its own verification rather than a drive-by. A guard beats the prose note in the PR body.

followUpRowsProposed.what: No committed instrument shows what the component picker actually renders.
followUpRowsProposed.detail: Grading reads per-story sheets captured through ?story=, which are unaffected by cardMode. The card render — the thing Nick QA-walks — is only visible by loading the component HTML at its declared viewport. That gap is why two cards reached this session rendering as empty white boxes with every check green. I built a throwaway script to see it and deleted it; it should be a committed capture mode instead.

followUpRowsProposed.what: Stage renders Max and Presented identically.
followUpRowsProposed.detail: Byte-identical captures. Authored content, graded good twice, outside this row's remedy scope, but the two cells buy nothing as a variant axis.

followUpRowsProposed.what: Product CSS for mx*, cite and atomchip.
followUpRowsProposed.detail: Carried forward unchanged from the handoff. Two of the five components 30b section 3.1 calls load-bearing, plus the atom chip, have no CSS in any shipped stylesheet, so the kit cannot wrap them and a design agent will invent them. conventions.md tells the agent not to. This is a card against smartcity-dashboards, not the kit, and it should exist before anyone designs a Plan Review surface.
